record.paper_title: Results and open problems in matchings in regular graphs
record.context_brief: Weak van der Waerden analog for haffnians
record.original_question: Let mu = lim_{n to infinity} log(mu_{n,n})/n, where mu_{n,n} is the minimum of haf_n(B) over B in Psi_{2n}. Is mu greater than negative infinity, equivalently does mu_{n,n} have at least an exponential-in-n lower bound rather than superexponential decay?

evidence.quote: A weak analog of the van der Waerden conjecture is the claim that µ > −∞.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an even integer $2n$, let $\mathcal{F}_{2n}$ denote the set of all $2n\times 2n$ symmetric $0/1$ matrices that are adjacency matrices of perfect matchings on the vertex set $\{1,2,\dots,2n\}$ (equivalently, symmetric permutation matrices of order $2n$ with zero diagonal whose underlying permutation is a fixed-point-free involution). Let
\[
\Psi_{2n} \;=\; \operatorname{conv}(\mathcal{F}_{2n})
\]
be the convex hull of $\mathcal{F}_{2n}$ inside the space of $2n\times 2n$ real symmetric matrices; equivalently, $\Psi_{2n}$ is the polytope of symmetric, entrywise non-negative, doubly stochastic matrices with zero diagonal that arise as convex combinations of perfect-matching adjacency matrices.

For a $2n\times 2n$ symmetric matrix $B=(b_{ij})$, the hafnian is defined by
\[
\operatorname{haf}_n(B) \;=\; \sum_{M} \prod_{\{i,j\}\in M} b_{ij},
\]
where the sum runs over all perfect matchings $M$ of $\{1,2,\dots,2n\}$.

Define
\[
\mu_{n,n} \;=\; \min_{B \in \Psi_{2n}} \operatorname{haf}_n(B), \qquad \mu \;=\; \limsup_{n\to\infty} \frac{\log \mu_{n,n}}{n}.
\]

Question. Does one have $\mu > -\infty$? Equivalently, does there exist a constant $c>0$ such that $\mu_{n,n} \ge e^{-cn}$ for all sufficiently large $n$, ruling out superexponential decay of $\mu_{n,n}$ to $0$?
artifact.category_tag: Hafnians and van der Waerden type conjectures
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed by Friedland as a weak analog of the van der Waerden permanent conjecture for hafnians on the polytope generated by symmetric perfect-matching matrices. No subsequent paper resolving even the weak form (existence of an exponential lower bound for the minimum hafnian on $\Psi_{2n}$) was found. Related work of Barvinok on approximating hafnians of doubly stochastic matrices indicates that no straightforward nontrivial lower bound is known, consistent with the problem still being open.

status_evidence.title: Analogs of the van der Waerden and Tverberg conjectures for haffnians
status_evidence.snippet: We discuss here analogs of van der Waerden and Tverberg permanent conjectures for haffnians on the convex set of matrices whose extreme points are symmetric permutation matrices with zero diagonal.
status_evidence.claim: States the framework (Psi_{2n}, hafnian) in which the weak van der Waerden analog mu > -infinity is formulated, with no resolution announced.

status_evidence.title: Approximating permanents and hafnians (Barvinok)
status_evidence.snippet: For symmetric matrices with non-negative entries, the Barvinok estimator gives a sub-exponential approximation; no nontrivial general lower bound for the hafnian of a doubly stochastic matrix is known.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the absence of a known nontrivial lower bound for hafnians of doubly stochastic matrices, consistent with the weak analog being unresolved.
